tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Screen background behind everything. Also the browser theme-color and the manifest background in each theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, settings groups, the selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: What sits above cards: the tab bar, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Fields, the track of segmented controls and switches, chips, the completed-day fill in the calendar, the done banner.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders of cards and rows, dividers, the outline of secondary buttons. Never text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, titles, primary labels and the wordmark, on page, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15.7:1 light, 15:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running authored text: hooks, the retelling, reflections, settings explanations. On page, surface and surface-raised (9.1:1 light, 10.3:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: References, dates, captions, inactive tab labels, placeholders, icon buttons at rest. At least 4.5:1 on page, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The stone of the identity: the door in the logo, the arch outline in illustrations, the step label in the guided experience, small section labels, the rule beside a reflection, favourite hearts. Not for buttons (that is cta). 4.8:1 light, 8.4:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: The one luminous colour, for action only: the primary button («عِش الدعاء», «التالي», «يا ربّ»), the selected choice ring, the completed-day dot, and the light inside the door. Never decoration, never text on page.

tokens.name: cta-text
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a cta fill (6:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered cta fill; cta-text stays readable on it.

tokens.name: sacred-quran
tokens.usage: Qur'an text, always inside SacredText on sacred-bg (17:1 light, 14.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: sacred-hadith
tokens.usage: Hadith text between « », on sacred-bg or surface (at least 7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: sacred-frame
tokens.usage: The 1px arch that frames sacred text, and the frame of the guided experience. Never around anything else.

tokens.name: sacred-bg
tokens.usage: Inside the arch frame, behind Qur'an and hadith text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The check in «دعوتَ الله اليوم بهذا الدعاء» and saved states. Always beside a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions («امسح كل بياناتي», delete) and errors. Always with a word and a confirmation step.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. At least 3:1 on page, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The light inside the door: radial-gradient(70% 42% at 50% 40%, glow, transparent 72%) behind the guided experience, the closing screen and empty-state arches. Nowhere else, and never over sacred text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding titles and the closing line «جعله الله دعاءً مستجابًا». One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles (المكتبة، الدفتر) and the dua title on its card.

styles.name: live
styles.sample: نبيٌّ في الظلمات، وحده، ينادي ربه.
styles.usage: The paced sentences of «عِش الدعاء», centred inside the arch.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles, the journal prompt, the title of an empty state.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: خلف كل دعاء في القرآن والسنة إنسانٌ في لحظة حقيقية.
styles.usage: Onboarding body and the full narration of a hadith.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: من أعمق مكان يمكن أن يصل إليه إنسان، وصل صوته.
styles.usage: Default reading text: the hook, the retelling, reflections, notebook entries. Never smaller for running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: دعا به يونس عليه السلام في بطن الحوت
styles.usage: The scene line under the sacred text, secondary text in rows, settings explanations.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Source references under sacred text, field labels, the step label of the guided experience (weight 600).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips, Hijri dates in lists, section labels above groups (weight 600, in accent).

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels only. Weight 700 for the current tab.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button labels. Secondary buttons use 16px at 500.

styles.name: quran
styles.usage: Qur'an text on the dua card, in the Madina Mushaf font with the King Fahd Complex text. Shrinks, never truncates.

styles.name: quran-live
styles.usage: Qur'an text in the «الدعاء» step of the guided experience.

styles.name: hadith
styles.usage: The dua text of a hadith card, between « », in the UI face with its full vowelling.

styles.name: hadith-full
styles.sample: نص الرواية كاملة كما نُسخت من المصدر
styles.usage: The full narration with its chain, in «نص الحديث كاملًا». No « » around it: the source has its own quotation marks.

spacing.note: A 4px scale, plus three named steps the screens use everywhere. Sizes are px at the default 16px text size; spacing does not grow with the text-size setting.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its hook; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related rows of a card (entry text and its actions).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between blocks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top padding of screen headers; sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Side padding of full-screen flows (onboarding, the guided experience).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above and below a centred empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between major sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every tabbed screen at phone width.

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Inner side padding of cards, list groups and section rows.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Gap between cards stacked on a screen, and between the blocks of the dua card.

size.note: Fixed sizes for touch and icons.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, icon buttons included.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary buttons.

tokens.name: button-height-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and card actions.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar and top bar icons.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the reading column on tablets and desktop; the column is centred.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner pieces: the selected segment (radius-control minus its 4px inset), the share-image thumbnail.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, choice tiles, the done banner.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups; also the bottom corners of the arch frame.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the tab highlight, switches, progress dots, calendar days.

tokens.name: frame-arch-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal radius of the arch's head (top corners of the frame). Pair with frame-arch-y: border-radius: frame-arch-x frame-arch-x radius-card radius-card / frame-arch-y frame-arch-y radius-card radius-card.

tokens.name: frame-arch-y
tokens.usage: Vertical radius of the arch's head. The head is always 3:2, wider than tall.

tokens.name: frame-arch-x-lg
tokens.usage: The arch on 1080px share images.

tokens.name: frame-arch-y-lg
tokens.usage: The arch on 1080px share images.

shadow.note: Stone is colour, not texture: depth comes from the surface steps and hairlines. Shadows stay faint.

tokens.name: card-shadow
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups and the selected segment.

tokens.name: raised-shadow
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs only.

duration.note: Motion is calm and short. With prefers-reduced-motion, every duration is 0 and nothing moves; the pacing of sentences still applies but each sentence appears without a fade.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Pressed states, switch knob, chevron turn.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: A paced sentence fading in; a disclosure opening.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs entering.

tokens.name: pace-sentence
tokens.usage: Interval between sentences in «عِش الدعاء». «أظهر النص كاملًا» skips it.

tokens.name: closing-hold
tokens.usage: How long «جعله الله دعاءً مستجابًا» stays before returning to Today.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or changes.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs leaving.
